title: How much does a financial advisor cost?
summary: Most financial advisors charge 0.25% to 1.5% of your assets a year, about $300 an hour, or a flat fee of a few hundred to several thousand dollars.
body_markdown:
## What do financial advisors charge?


Here’s what published fee schedules look like. Each firm’s price below comes from its own pricing page or disclosure document.


**Percentage of assets.** Full-service advisors who build a plan and manage your money tend to sit around 1% a year. Kitces Research found that portfolios under $1 million average between 1% and 1.2%, with the rate falling as balances grow. Edward Jones’s Advisory Solutions Fund Models program charges 1.35% on the first $250,000, stepping down to 0.50% above $10 million, plus a separate platform fee. Fidelity Wealth Services ranges from 0.50% to 1.50% a year depending on the amount invested, with a $50,000 minimum. Hybrid services that pair software with human advisors cost less. Vanguard Personal Advisor charges about 0.30% a year on an all-index portfolio, with a $50,000 minimum.


**Robo-advisors.** Automated portfolios are the cheapest percentage option. Wealthfront charges 0.25% a year, Betterment charges 0.25% once you meet its balance or deposit threshold and Fidelity Go charges nothing under $25,000 and 0.35% above it.


**Flat and subscription fees.** Facet’s plans start at $2,600 a year at list price. Range’s plans start at $3,950 a year. Schwab Intelligent Portfolios Premium charges a one-time $300 planning fee, then $30 a month. Across the industry, Kitces Research found the median flat fee was $4,500 a year in 2024.


**Hourly.** Kitces Research puts the average at about $300 an hour.


Rates usually fall at higher balances, and a fee that covers tax, estate and insurance planning costs more than one for investments alone. Kitces Research found advisors attribute about 41% of an asset-based fee, on average, to planning and other services. Stock options, a business or rental property take more of an advisor’s time and usually cost more.
